mapper.select: INSERT INTO generation_tasks (novel_id, from_chapter, to_chapter, submitted_by) VALUES (#{novelId}, #{fromChapter}, #{toChapter}, #{submittedBy}) RETURNING id

SELECT t.id, t.novel_id, n.title, t.from_chapter, t.to_chapter, t.status, t.done_chapters, t.current_chapter, t.last_message, t.create_time FROM generation_tasks t JOIN novels n ON n.id = t.novel_id WHERE t.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id FROM generation_tasks WHERE status = 'QUEUED' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE generation_tasks SET status='RUNNING', current_chapter=from_chapter, update_time=now() WHERE id=#{id} AND status='QUEUED'
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.novel_id, n.title, t.from_chapter, t.to_chapter, t.status, t.done_chapters, t.current_chapter, t.last_message, t.create_time FROM generation_tasks t JOIN novels n ON n.id = t.novel_id WHERE t.status = 'RUNNING' ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE generation_tasks SET done_chapters=#{doneChapters}, current_chapter=#{currentChapter}, last_message=#{message}, update_time=now() WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE generation_tasks SET status=#{status}, last_message=#{message}, update_time=now() WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE generation_tasks SET status='CANCELED', last_message='提交后取消', update_time=now() WHERE id=#{id} AND status='QUEUED'
mapper.select: SELECT status FROM generation_tasks WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE generation_tasks SET status='QUEUED', last_message='重启重排', update_time=now() WHERE status='RUNNING' AND is_deleted=false
